description: Negative control C1 for ticket 18: the ONE case cbrd_26659_oos_rep10_many_stubs, run against a generated scenario carrying two planted defects, one per checking mechanism this ticket relies on. (a) The CTP comparison: one hex digit of the eighteen-column record's v18 digest is changed in a copy of the promoted answer -- v18 is one of the six columns that stay INLINE, so a comparison that only looked at demoted values would pass. (b) The spec-driven OOS-path evidence checker: the expected chunk count for that record is 11 instead of 12 in evidence/ticket18/controls/. Both must fail. Rebuild the scenario with evidence/ticket18/make_control_c1.sh, which only ever reads from the testcase repository. A checker-validation attempt gets no manifest and never reaches the coverage matrix.
